about: Grande Prairie County No. 1 is a municipal district in northwestern Alberta surrounding—but separate from—the City of Grande Prairie. Hamlets such as Clairmont, Sexsmith’s rural edges, Bezanson, and Teepee Creek sit among grain fields, oil and gas activity, and boreal-parkland countryside. It is a rural municipality, not the city itself. About 24,000 people live in Grande Prairie County No. 1.
